summary: Enabled a persistent firewalld policy on node1. SSH and TCP/8080 are accepted on eth0; unmatched inbound IPv4 and IPv6 traffic is rejected. The policy and SSH service recovered after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Added TCP/8080 to the permanent public firewalld zone and reloaded it.
Verified runtime and permanent SSH and TCP/8080 allowances.
Verified terminal IPv4 and IPv6 REJECT rules.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified firewalld, sshd, the SSH listener, and all firewall rules after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: Shows successful persistent configuration, runtime/permanent allowances for TCP/22 and TCP/8080, eth0 zone assignment, and terminal IPv4/IPv6 REJECT rules before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID 2fc81aed-3ce8-4a35-8f4c-b73206afa45f, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 96f5af2f-7835-4921-8a21-e77d4da4e34d, and recovered firewalld, sshd, listener, and persistent policy.
